event: Build with MUSD and MEZO: Bitcoin’s Economic Layer
tracks: Track 1: DeFi - borrowing, lending, looping, yield with MUSD/MEZO
Track 2: Access & Distribution - tools, bots, interfaces for MUSD/MEZO users

steps: Judging closes -> your dollar share is fixed by points
Winner announcement -> KYB request by email
You complete KYB -> the 14-day TWAP of MEZO ending that day sets your token count
Payment initiated same day if a working day, else the next working day
payout.formula: MEZO received = dollar share / 14-day TWAP on your KYB day

plays: Route comparison, gas estimates, tBTC to MUSD path
Invoices and payments where users already are
Deposit MUSD, supply to a money market, leveraged MEZO
